description: TNO’s repository supplies simulation files for one realisation of the Brugge reservoir-management benchmark, together with static inputs for a FlowNet variant. The README traces the synthetic benchmark to the 2008 workshop and later extension. The provider is TNO. Coverage: Brugge is a fictitious field, not the Belgian city’s geology. This repository covers one realisation; a separate route is given for the full benchmark collection. Access: Only the public README and data-use conditions were read. Files and the full benchmark were not obtained. Licence and cost: The provider permits noncommercial use subject to acknowledgement and disclaims warranties. Commercial use requires prior contact; no terms were accepted here. Limitations: The selected realisation does not equal the full Brugge dataset. Synthetic reservoir assumptions and case-specific schedules limit transfer to field decisions. For simulation it supports reservoir history-matching and closed-loop management comparisons. Related resources: No related catalogue record was established as an input, dependency or companion from the provider metadata.
